research.title: Introduction to Research
research.content:
The Research Machine is your gateway to new technologies and an understanding of the world's anomalies.

Build a Laboratory Bench at an ordinary workbench. The Field Scanner, Research Tablet, Research Machine and their basic resonite components are available from the start. Mine shards and raw resonite beneath anomalies, then smelt the resonite in an ordinary furnace.

Coils, circuits and stabilized cores can be assembled at the Laboratory Bench before completing any experiments. Use these to build the Research Machine, then study anomalies to unlock powered equipment.

research.title: The Field Scanner
research.content:
The Field Scanner is your primary tool for detecting and analyzing anomalies.

To use: Hold it and right-click while looking at an anomaly. The scanner will analyze it and automatically add research points to your tablet!

Different anomalies provide different types and amounts of research points based on their nature and power level.

research.title: The Research Tablet
research.content:
The Research Tablet tracks your accumulated research points and unlocked technologies.

Right-click while holding it to open the research interface and view all available research nodes.

Click any locked node to view its requirements. If you have enough points, spend them to receive research notes for that technology!

research.title: Using the Research Machine
research.content:
To use the Research
Machine:

1. Place research notes
   in the machine's
   input slot
2. Click 'Begin
   Research' to start
   the process
3. Complete the
   minigames that
   appear to stabilize
   the research
4. Successfully
   completing research
   unlocks new
   technologies

research.title: Research Minigames
research.content:
During research,
you'll encounter
various minigames
that represent
stabilizing different
types of anomaly
energy:

• Energy: Adjust waves
• Cognition: Memorize
• Space: Correct space
• Gravity: Balance
• Time: Synchronize
• Shadow: Align

Each minigame becomes
unstable over time.

research.title: Understanding Instability
research.content:
Instability is a critical
concept in anomaly study:

• All minigames stable:
  Instability decreases
• Any minigame unstable:
  Instability increases

If the experiment becomes
too unstable then the
research fails.
Reduce instability to zero
to successfully complete
the research.

field_scanner.title: Field Scanner
field_scanner.content:
The Field Scanner is an
essential tool for
detecting and analyzing
anomaly phenomena in the
world around you.

This handheld device can
identify different types
of anomalies and provide
valuable data for your
research.

anomaly_resonator.title: Anomaly Resonator
anomaly_resonator.content:
BREAKTHROUGH! My most
advanced detection device!
This compass locates
anomalies and syncs with
their energy signatures.

Unlike the Field Scanner,
the Resonator provides
precise directional
guidance and resonance
links with anomalies.

Construct with materials
shown in recipe.

anomaly_resonator.title: How It Works
anomaly_resonator.content:
The Resonator operates on advanced resonant detection:

• Compass needle points to nearest anomalies
• Synchronization mode creates energy links
• Tracks multiple anomaly sources

Usage:

1. Hold and observe needle direction
2. Follow needle to locate sources
3. Right-click near anomalies to sync
4. Monitor readings for type identification
5. Use data for research projects

anomaly_shards.title: Anomaly Shards
anomaly_shards.content:
FASCINATING! These
crystalline formations
are the physical
manifestation of
anomaly energy!

Each shard contains
pure, concentrated
anomaly essence that
can be harvested and
studied. They form
beneath active
anomalies like
crystalline tears
in reality itself!

anomaly_shards.title: Formation Process
anomaly_shards.content:
My research has revealed that anomaly shards form through a process I call 'Reality Crystallization'!

When anomalies remain active in an area, their energy seeps into the rock below, slowly crystallizing into pure anomaly matter.

It's like watching reality itself crystallize!

anomaly_shards.title: Shard Categories
anomaly_shards.content:
Each type of anomaly produces its own unique shard variety:

• Gravitics: Red-orange gravity-distorting crystals
• Chrono: Golden yellow time-frozen gems
• Spatial: Blue dimension-bending shards
• Energetic: Cyan blue energy-condensed crystals
• Shade: Purple shadow-crystallized matter
• Insight: Green thought-crystallized fragments

anomaly_shards.title: Collection Methods
anomaly_shards.content:
To harvest these precious specimens:

1. Locate active anomalies
2. Dig down beneath the anomaly site
3. Look for crystallized deposits in the rock
4. Mine carefully - these are delicate specimens!

Each shard type has unique properties that make them valuable for advanced research.

anomaly_types.title: Anomaly Types
anomaly_types.content:
EUREKA! After years of meticulous study, I have identified the six fundamental types of anomaly phenomena that permeate our reality! Each type represents a different aspect of dimensional instability, and understanding their properties is crucial to mastering anomaly science.

These six types form the foundation of all anomaly research. Every strange occurrence, every dimensional rift, every temporal distortion can be classified into one of these fundamental categories. They are the building blocks of reality itself, twisted and warped by forces beyond normal comprehension!

Mastering these types opens the door to advanced anomaly manipulation and containment techniques.

anomaly_types.title: The Six Fundamental Types
anomaly_types.content:
The six fundamental anomaly types I have catalogued:

• GRAVITY: Distorts gravitational fields, causes floating objects and anti-gravity zones
• TIME: Manipulates temporal flow, creates time loops and temporal echoes
• SPACE: Warps dimensional space, creates teleportation effects
• ENERGY: Disrupts electromagnetic fields, causes energy storms
• SHADOW: Creates dimensional voids and shadow portals
• COGNITION: Affects mental perception, causes hallucinations and thought-forms

anomaly_types.title: Type Interactions
anomaly_types.content:
FASCINATING DISCOVERY! The anomaly types interact in complex ways:

• Gravity + Space = Dimensional rifts to other realities
• Time + Energy = Temporal energy storms
• Shadow + Cognition = Shadow entities
• Space + Time = Warp gates for instant travel
• Gravity + Energy = Gravitational energy wells
• Cognition + Time = Memory loops across timelines

Understanding these interactions is key to creating stable containment systems and advanced research equipment!

anomaly_types.title: Research Applications
anomaly_types.content:
The practical applications of anomaly type knowledge:

• GRAVITY: Anti-gravity technology and energy generation
• TIME: Temporal research facilities and time-dilated chambers
• SPACE: Teleportation networks and dimensional storage
• ENERGY: Unlimited power sources and electromagnetic weapons
• SHADOW: Dimensional travel and stealth technology
• COGNITION: Mind-machine interfaces and enhanced learning

Each type requires specialized equipment and containment procedures. This knowledge is the foundation of all advanced anomaly technology!

resonite.title: Resonite
resonite.content:
FASCINATING DISCOVERY! This
crystalline ore is the key
to unlocking anomaly
energy!

Resonite spawns naturally
in the world, but is most
easily found underneath
anomalies where reality
becomes thin.

This precious material
holds the power to
channel and amplify
anomaly frequencies!

resonite.title: Resonant Coil
resonite.content:
My first breakthrough in
resonite applications!

The Resonant Coil is a
fundamental component
that can channel and
amplify anomaly energy.

It serves as the
foundation for more
complex devices and
can be used to create
resonance circuits.

resonite.title: Resonant Circuit
resonite.content:
BREAKTHROUGH ACHIEVEMENT!
The Resonant Circuit
represents the pinnacle
of resonite technology!

This advanced component
can process multiple
anomaly frequencies
simultaneously and
stabilize complex
energy patterns.

Essential for advanced
research equipment!

resonite.title: A Home for Strange Science
resonite.content:
Resonite can make more than machines. Open the Furniture tab at your Laboratory Bench to craft beds, seats, storage and wall fittings.

Sit down after a long experiment, sleep in your new bed or keep your discoveries safe in a chest. Place two matching chests side by side to make a large chest. Shelves and monitors bring the room to life.

resonite.title: Building Your Laboratory
resonite.content:
The Building tab holds floors, stairs, doors and matching roof pieces. Place stairs beside one another to form corners. Roofs also join as you build.

Use shallow roofs for a broad shelter and steep roofs for a tall laboratory. Matching flat pieces finish the top.

resonant_energy.title: Resonant Energy Fundamentals
resonant_energy.content:
Gadgets store Resonant Energy (RE). This is electrical power, separate from the Energy observations in your research journal. Crafted gadgets begin at full charge. An empty gadget remains intact and can always be recharged.

The burner, conduits and charging station form your first power network. Build them at the Laboratory Bench and supply fuel to keep your equipment charged.

resonant_energy.title: Fuel becomes power
resonant_energy.content:
Craft the Resonant Burner at the Laboratory Bench. Fuel produces a shared store of RE. Its separate gadget dock charges a single gadget directly from that store; the ordinary inventory continues to accept fuel.

The dock transfers up to 200 RE per second while energy remains available. You may remove your gadget at any charge level.

resonant_energy.title: Connect the laboratory
resonant_energy.content:
Place Resonant Conduits between the burner and charging station. Connected machines share the actual generated supply: conduits cannot create power. A station directly adjacent to the burner can connect without an intervening conduit.

Coils, conduits and the charging station use ordinary laboratory materials. No captured anomaly or Reality Forge is needed to establish charging.

resonant_energy.title: The charging cradle
resonant_energy.content:
The charging station holds one gadget and buffers up to 10,000 RE. It transfers up to 800 RE per second while supplied with enough power. Its native gadget slot preserves the item and its stored energy when moved or saved.

Automated tubes insert depleted gadgets and extract them once full. Manual removal works at any charge level. Battery packs recharge in this same slot.

resonant_energy.title: Store a reserve
resonant_energy.content:
Resonant Energy Storage buffers up to 60,000 RE and starts empty. It accepts spare generation and supplies machines later, up to 400 RE per second. Craft it at the Laboratory Bench.

Use the block to configure each of its six faces as Input, Output or Disabled. The front is an output by default; the other five faces are inputs. These faces follow the block when it is rotated. Route conduits from your generator to an input, and from an output to your machines.

Storage does not generate power. Pack Up preserves its charge and face settings when moving it.

resonant_energy.title: Keep your scanner ready
resonant_energy.content:
A Field Scanner begins with 2,000 RE, enough for 100 fresh completed scans at the default settings. Cancelled scans and previously recorded fields cost nothing. Recharge before a long expedition.

The energy bar on the gadget HUD shows your remaining charge. Empty gadgets remain intact; put them in the burner dock or a supplied charging station to restore their power.

reality_forge.title: Reality Forge
reality_forge.content:
The Reality Forge represents
the pinnacle of anomaly
manipulation technology.

This remarkable device
infuses normal items with
the concentrated energy
from anomaly shards,
transforming them into
powerful anomalous
artifacts.

Through careful
frequency alignment, it
can channel the unique
properties of each
anomaly type into
ordinary materials.

reality_forge.title: Using the Reality Forge
reality_forge.content:
The Reality Forge operates
on principles of resonant
frequency manipulation.

Place your target item
in the main slot, then
select the appropriate
anomaly shard type.

The forge will carefully
infuse the item with
anomaly energy, creating
new properties and
capabilities.

Each shard type produces
different effects on the
infused item.

reality_forge.title: Powered forging
reality_forge.content: The Reality Forge now uses resonant power. Keep ingredients in its supply inventory. Starting a job reserves those exact materials. A lack of power pauses progress. Stop returns reserved ingredients without refunding power already used. Finished items stay in the output inventory. Repeat uses the owner's discoveries.

reality_forge_category.title: Reality Forge
reality_forge_category.content:
The Reality Forge represents
the pinnacle of anomaly
manipulation technology.

This remarkable device
infuses normal items with
the concentrated energy
from anomaly shards,
transforming them into
powerful anomalous
artifacts.

Through careful
frequency alignment, it
can channel the unique
properties of each
anomaly type into
ordinary materials.

reality_forge_category.title: Using the Reality Forge
reality_forge_category.content:
The Reality Forge operates
on principles of resonant
frequency manipulation.

Place your target item
in the main slot, then
select the appropriate
anomaly shard type.

The forge will carefully
infuse the item with
anomaly energy, creating
new properties and
capabilities.

Each shard type produces
different effects on the
infused item.

resonance_condenser.title: Resonance Condenser
resonance_condenser.content:
The Resonance Condenser
represents a breakthrough
in anomaly energy
manipulation.

This advanced device
condenses the energies
from nearby anomalies
in a sped-up manner to
form anomaly shards
through accelerated
crystallization.

It dramatically reduces
the time required for
shard formation.

resonance_condenser.title: How It Works
resonance_condenser.content:
The condenser operates
by creating a localized
resonance field that
amplifies the natural
crystallization process.

When placed near active
anomalies, it draws in
ambient anomaly energy
and accelerates the
formation of shards
beneath the anomaly.

The process is
significantly faster
than natural formation
but requires precise
calibration.

containment_basics.title: Containment Basics
containment_basics.content:
BREAKTHROUGH! At last I
have developed the
fundamental tools for
anomaly containment!

The Echo Vacuum is my
most sophisticated
device for capturing
and containing
anomalous entities.

This revolutionary
tool can safely
contain anomalies
for further study
and analysis.

containment_basics.title: Containment Capsules
containment_basics.content:
The containment capsule
represents the pinnacle
of anomaly containment
technology.

These specialized
containers can safely
hold captured anomalies
for extended periods
without degradation.

Essential for
transporting and
storing anomalous
entities for detailed
scientific analysis.

echoform_imprinter.title: Identity Transference
echoform_imprinter.content:
UNPRECEDENTED BREAKTHROUGH!
I have done the IMPOSSIBLE!

The Echoform Imprinter
scans a living being's
echoform - their shadow-
cognitive imprint!

I can TEMPORARILY mimic
their physical form!

The scientific potential
is EXTRAORDINARY!

echoform_imprinter.title: Operational Protocols
echoform_imprinter.content:
Operating the Echoform Imprinter requires precise technique:

TO SCAN:
Hold right-click on any creature for ONE SECOND.

TO REVERT:
Shift + right-click to return to normal.

FEATURES:
• Works on ANY living entity
• Scan PLAYERS to copy appearance
• Perfect mimicry with animations
• Completely reversible

Ideal for infiltration and research!

echoform_imprinter.title: Shadow-Cognitive Theory
echoform_imprinter.content:
Every entity casts TWO imprints:

PHYSICAL SHADOW:
Cast by blocking light.

COGNITIVE ECHOFORM:
A PERFECT template of physical structure in reality itself!

APPLICATIONS:
• Infiltration and espionage
• Understanding alien biology
• Deception and disguise
• Safe anomaly interaction

The implications are STAGGERING!

warp_gun.title: Warp Gun
warp_gun.content:
REVOLUTIONARY DISCOVERY!
I have created the
ultimate portable
teleportation device!

The Warp Gun allows
instantaneous travel
through personal warp
gates that I can
create anywhere.

This breakthrough
represents the
pinnacle of spatial
anomaly manipulation!

warp_gun.title: Teleportation Mechanics
warp_gun.content:
The Warp Gun operates through paired spatial anomalies that create stable wormholes.

Left click fires a primary warp gate that anchors to the target location.

Right click fires a secondary warp gate that connects to the primary.

You can then teleport instantly between the two gates!

chrono_blister.title: Chrono Blister
chrono_blister.content:
BREAKTHROUGH IN TEMPORAL
MANIPULATION!

I have successfully
harnessed temporal
anomaly energy to
create a device that
can slow time itself!

The Chrono Blister
fires projectiles that
spawn fields of time
dilation, creating
zones where all
movement slows
proportionally.

chrono_blister.title: Time Dilation Mechanics
chrono_blister.content:
The Chrono Blister creates time dilation blocks that slow all movement uniformly.

When a projectile hits, it spawns a blob of time dilation blocks in a small radius.

These blocks are walkable-through but slow ALL movement - including gravity, horizontal movement, and projectiles.

Arrows still land in the same place, they just take longer to get there.

The blocks slowly decay over time, eventually disappearing like leaves.

stasis_projector.title: Stasis Projector
stasis_projector.content:
EXTRAORDINARY BREAKTHROUGH!
I have achieved what I
thought impossible - the
complete suspension of
matter in space-time!

By combining gravitational
field manipulation with
temporal distortion, I
have created a device
that can FREEZE objects
in a localized stasis
field!

The Stasis Projector
represents the pinnacle
of gravitational and
temporal anomaly
control technology!

stasis_projector.title: How It Works
stasis_projector.content:
The Stasis Projector operates on a revolutionary principle:

By creating a localized gravitational well combined with temporal distortion, objects within the field experience ZERO time flow while maintaining physical presence!

Shift right-click to activate/deactivate the field.

When active:
• Captures one item OR entity within range
• Suspends target above projector
• Prevents item pickup and entity AI
• Items never despawn
• Mobs cannot attack or move

Perfect for displaying rare artifacts or containing dangerous specimens!

stasis_projector.title: Scientific Applications
stasis_projector.content:
The applications of this technology are LIMITLESS!

MUSEUM DISPLAYS: Showcase rare items in suspended animation with no risk of theft or decay! The stasis field keeps artifacts perfectly preserved and visible.

SPECIMEN CONTAINMENT: Safely contain dangerous mobs for study without risk of escape or aggression!

rift_stabilizer.title: Rift Stabilizer
rift_stabilizer.content:
EUREKA! UNPRECEDENTED
BREAKTHROUGH!

I have achieved DIRECT
energy extraction from
Energetic Rift anomalies!

The Rift Stabilizer
creates a resonance
field that SIPHONS raw
anomaly energy and
converts it into stable,
usable power!

No fuel! No combustion!
Just pure, limitless
energy drawn from the
very fabric of reality
itself!

rift_stabilizer.title: Power Generation Theory
rift_stabilizer.content:
The Rift Stabilizer operates on revolutionary principles I've discovered through years of study!

By creating a focused resonance field pointed directly at an Energetic Rift, the device establishes a stable energy channel - a brilliant lightning bridge of pure anomaly power!

CRITICAL OPERATIONAL REQUIREMENTS:
• Must be within range of Energetic Rift
• Front face MUST point toward the rift
• Each rift supports limited stabilizers
• Generates constant power every tick
• Energy output through back face only

The visible electrical beam confirms proper alignment and active power generation!

rift_stabilizer.title: Installation & Operation
rift_stabilizer.content:
INSTALLATION PROTOCOLS FOR OPTIMAL RESULTS:

1. Locate an active Energetic Rift anomaly
2. Place stabilizer within detection range
3. FRONT FACE (intake) must point at rift!
4. BACK FACE (output) connects to machines

When properly aligned, you'll witness a magnificent electrical beam connecting the rift directly to the stabilizer!

Right-click the block to check current power generation status and stored energy levels.

The device requires NO fuel and operates continuously as long as the rift remains active and within range!

rift_stabilizer.title: Anomaly Nullifier
rift_stabilizer.content:
The Anomaly Nullifier keeps a laboratory safe from nearby anomaly effects. Its field reaches 12 blocks in every direction.

Place it near the area you want to protect. Use the device to turn it on or off. It needs no fuel or resonant power.

Suppression leaves the anomalies intact. Turning the device off restores their effects. The glowing core shows when it is suppressing a nearby anomaly.

levitation_pad.title: Levitation Pad
levitation_pad.content:
REVOLUTIONARY BREAKTHROUGH!
I have mastered the art
of controlled levitation!

The Levitation Pad
creates a powerful
anti-gravity field that
can lift players,
mobs, and items
up to 16 blocks high!

This device represents
the pinnacle of
gravitational anomaly
manipulation technology!

levitation_pad.title: Levitation Mechanics
levitation_pad.content:
The Levitation Pad operates through advanced gravitational field manipulation:

UP MODE (Default):
• Lifts entities upward within 16 blocks
• Stops at first solid block encountered
• Prevents fall damage during descent
• Works on players, mobs, and items

DOWN MODE (Right-click to toggle):
• Slowly lowers entities to ground level
• Provides controlled descent
• Eliminates fall damage completely
• Perfect for safe transportation

The visible levitation beam shows the active field range and current mode.

hoverboard.title: Hoverboard
hoverboard.content:
BREAKTHROUGH! I have created
the ultimate personal
transportation device!

The Hoverboard uses
advanced anti-gravity
technology to hover
smoothly above any
surface.

This revolutionary
vehicle provides
unprecedented mobility
and freedom of
travel across any
type of terrain!

graviton_hammer.title: Graviton Hammer
graviton_hammer.content:
After months of research
into gravitational
anomaly manipulation,
I have finally created
the ultimate mining
tool.

The Graviton Hammer
harnesses gravitational
fields to mine in
3x3 patterns, making
it incredibly efficient
for large-scale
excavation.

graviton_hammer.title: Mining Mechanics
graviton_hammer.content:
The Graviton Hammer operates through two distinct modes:

• Left-click mining creates 3x3 patterns. The orientation depends on the block face - horizontal planes for top/bottom faces, perpendicular planes for cardinal faces.

• Right-click charging accumulates gravitational energy. The longer I hold, the deeper the resulting tunnel becomes.

Three charge levels provide increasingly powerful tunnel mining. The tool has infinite durability, cannot be enchanted, but equals diamond mining level with iron pickaxe speed.

gravity_anomalies.title: Gravity Anomalies
gravity_anomalies.content:
Gravity anomalies make nearby players, creatures and loose items float. Your movement carries you into the field, then slowly eases as you drift and gently bob through the air. Use your movement controls to steer. Look up or down and move forward to rise or sink. Release the controls to keep drifting. Leave the field to feel gravity again.

Around a wild anomaly, loose blocks of ground can rise to different heights and gently sway and tilt around it. These blocks are solid. A Tinfoil Hat lets you walk on them without floating yourself.

Capture or turn off the anomaly and its ground returns. A field released from a capsule still makes things float, but leaves your laboratory floor alone.

temporal_anomalies.title: Temporal Anomalies
temporal_anomalies.content:
BREAKTHROUGH! Temporal
anomalies are rare
manifestations of
time distortion
phenomena.

These temporal blooms
create localized
regions where time
flows differently,
allowing for
accelerated or
slowed processes.

They represent the
ultimate frontier in
anomaly research -
the manipulation of
time itself!

spatial_anomalies.title: Spatial Anomalies
spatial_anomalies.content:
REVOLUTIONARY! Spatial
anomalies manifest as
warp gates that create
stable wormholes
between locations.

These warp gate
anomalies can connect
distant points in
space, enabling
instantaneous
travel.

They represent the
pinnacle of spatial
manipulation
technology and are
essential for advanced
teleportation systems.

energy_anomalies.title: Energy Anomalies
energy_anomalies.content:
INCREDIBLE! Energy
anomalies manifest as
energetic rifts that
channel raw anomaly
energy.

These rifts create
localized energy
fields that can
power advanced
technology or
provide research
opportunities.

They are the key to
understanding how
to harness anomaly
energy for practical
applications.

shadow_anomalies.title: Shadow Anomalies
shadow_anomalies.content:
MYSTERIOUS! Shadow
anomalies take the
form of echoing
shadows that seem
to exist between
realities.

These entities create
localized regions
of shadow energy
that can affect
visibility and
perception.

They represent the
most enigmatic type
of anomaly and
require careful
study to understand
their properties.

cognitive_anomalies.title: Cognitive Anomalies
cognitive_anomalies.content:
Thoughtwells cloud your senses. A blue haze fills your sight and your steps become slower.

Stay close and a wolf, floating spectre or crawler may appear beside your view and move toward you. It vanishes in a cloud moments later. These false creatures cannot hurt you, and other explorers do not see them. You may also hear footsteps where nobody is walking.

The closer you are, the more often these visions appear. They wear off after you leave. Nearby real creatures may briefly look like something else and forget what they were chasing.

Wear a Tinfoil Hat to protect your thoughts and stop the visions.

tinfoil_hat.title: Tinfoil Hat Protection
tinfoil_hat.content:
A Tinfoil Hat protects you from the tricks of several anomalies. It stops Thoughtwell visions, shields you from energetic rift shocks and lets you move normally near gravity anomalies.

Wear it on your head. Carrying it in your bag will not protect you.

It offers little protection in a fight, but a clear head can save your life in the field.

tinfoil_hat.title: Crafting the Tinfoil Hat
tinfoil_hat.content: The Tinfoil Hat is crafted using 5 resonite ingots arranged in a helmet pattern in a standard crafting table:

resonant_separation.title: Resonant Separation
resonant_separation.content: Supply the Resonant Separator with supported raw ore and resonant power. It makes twice the normal metal yield as concentrate. Smelt concentrate in a regular furnace or a Flux Furnace. Bars, blocks, shards and concentrate cannot be separated again.

flux_smelting.title: Flux Smelting
flux_smelting.content: The Flux Furnace uses resonant power instead of fuel. Insert ordinary furnace ingredients or metal concentrate and it chooses the recipe automatically. It keeps all recipe outputs and smelts twenty percent faster than a regular furnace at the same tier. Electricity makes no charcoal. Upgrade inside the machine to add five ingredient slots and improve its speed.

gravitic_transport.title: Gravitic Transport
gravitic_transport.content: Connect Gravitic Tubes to supported storage and machine inventories. Choose Take from container at the source and Send into container at the destination. Set the correct ingredient, fuel or finished item section. Filters, priority and stock limits control each connection. Tubes need no resonant power. Items stay in their source until the visible batch arrives safely.

pattern_assembly.title: Pattern Assembly
pattern_assembly.content: Press Choose Recipe to open the Workbench category tabs. Pick a discovered recipe, then supply its ingredients and resonant power. Craft once or enable Repeat and choose how many finished items to keep in this machine. The assembler works slowly for you while powered. The owner provides recipe knowledge, even while offline. Visitors cannot lend their discoveries. Upgrade using the ordinary Workbench tier materials plus resonant parts. Other crafting stations keep their own recipes.

resonant_battery_pack.title: Portable reserve
resonant_battery_pack.content:
Twin caged resonant cells carry 60,000 RE on your back. Equip the pack in the chest equipment slot. It provides no armor resistance.

The pack transfers up to 200 RE per second across your inventory. Your held gadget receives power first; other depleted gadgets take turns sharing the remaining allowance. Packs do not recharge each other.

Remove the pack to stop automatic transfer. Recharge it in the station or burner dock.

gravitic_manipulation.title: Carry a suspended target
gravitic_manipulation.content:
Secondary captures the aimed ordinary block, dropped item or eligible creature within 8 blocks. It floats about 3 blocks ahead of you. Secondary again gently releases it.

Primary launches your held target along your aim. Blocks and chests settle in clear space. Single and joined chests keep their inventory, item data and facing; joined chests require room for the entire chest. Chest access pauses briefly while a placement is saved. If no safe placement is available, the original location is used when it becomes clear. The manipulator never overwrites occupied terrain. Other machines, fluids, players and protected blocks cannot be transported.

Acquisition costs 100 RE, holding uses 40 RE per second and launching costs 300 RE. Releasing is always available, even when empty. Switching items, losing the target or leaving the world safely releases it.

arc_projection.title: Electricity under control
arc_projection.content:
Hold primary to fire five electrical pulses per second. Each pulse traces up to 18 blocks and can arc through three additional hostile enemies within 5 blocks of the preceding target. Walls stop both the first strike and subsequent hops.

Damage falls to 75 percent at each hop. A brief movement slow helps contain crowds without permanent stuns. The bolt uses the same bright electrical filament seen between an Energetic Rift and a Rift Stabilizer.

Every fired pulse uses 200 RE, including misses. The 12,000 RE reserve allows 60 pulses before recharging. A battery pack extends this reserve but cannot sustain continuous fire.
